_note: Anti-scam phone simulator (design spec section 7). Senders are fictional; every screen is labelled SIMULATION. Loss and bounty amounts are mirrored in public.scam_rule() (migration *_scam_simulator.sql) and checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs. Losses are always capped at 10% of the balance and AED 5,000.

lines: This is Captain Mansoor from the Dubai Life Police.
Your Resident Card has been linked to a money-laundering ring.
We've sent a 6-digit code to your phone. Read it back now to clear your record, or we issue a warrant today.
redFlags: Police never ask for codes over the phone
Threats and a deadline to rush you
A code sent to you is for you only
scams.realWorld: In the UAE, real police never call to ask for an OTP or bank details. Hang up and report it through the official police app or website.

scams.preview: RoadPass: your tag has a negative balance
lines: Your RoadPass tag has a negative balance (-14.00 AED). Pay within 2 hours to avoid a 400 AED fine: roadpass-tag-pay.cc
redFlags: A tiny amount with a big fine
scams.realWorld: Toll operators send balance alerts from their official sender and you top up in their official app, never through a link in a text.

scams.preview: City Post: your package is on hold
lines: Package AE-9941 is held at the sorting centre. Pay 13.50 AED customs fee: citypost-secure.top
redFlags: Card details for a tiny fee
scams.realWorld: Fake delivery-fee texts are among the most common scams. Check deliveries in the courier's official app, and never enter card details from a text link.

lines: Hey! I accidentally sent my ChatApp 6-digit PIN to your number by mistake.
Can you send it back to me? 🙏
redFlags: A code sent to your number is for your account
A 'friend' asking for codes may already be hacked
scams.realWorld: Sharing a verification code lets scammers take over your messaging account and message your friends. Never forward codes, even to friends.

scams.preview: Earn AED 500 a day from your phone?
lines: Earn 500 AED a day by just liking 5 restaurants on maps!
To unlock your first task batch, send a 200 AED deposit. Bigger batches pay more.
redFlags: Returns that are too good to be true
scams.realWorld: Task scams start with small payouts to win your trust, then ask for bigger and bigger deposits. Real jobs never ask you to pay to work.
